analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is documented, architecture is designed, services are rewritten, QA/security checks are performed, requirements are validated, and the application is deployed for local Docker testing.
requirements_understanding: The legacy application is a VB6 banking application with forms for various banking operations.
The modernization involves translating VB6 code to C# while maintaining existing functionalities.
The application should be containerized for local testing using Docker.
QA and security checks are mandatory before deployment.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Translate VB6 forms and logic to C# using modern design patterns.
Implement a microservices architecture for scalability and maintainability.
Use Docker for containerization to facilitate local testing and deployment.
Ensure backward compatibility in terms of functionality and data handling.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific new features or changes in functionality expected during modernization?
What are the specific security standards or frameworks to be adhered to during QA checks?

output.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring all functionalities are preserved and enhanced with modern architecture, security, and testing practices.

functional_requirements.title: Translate Login Form to C#
functional_requirements.description: Convert the VB6 login form to a C# form, maintaining existing authentication logic.
acceptance_criteria: The login form should authenticate users using the same credentials as the legacy system.
The form should display appropriate error messages for invalid credentials.
Successful login should redirect users to the main dashboard.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Customer Management Service
functional_requirements.description: Create a C# service for managing customer data, replacing the legacy VB6 functionality.
acceptance_criteria: The service should allow CRUD operations on customer data.
Data integrity must be maintained during all operations.
The service should log all operations for audit purposes.

functional_requirements.title: Develop Transaction Processing Service
functional_requirements.description: Implement a C# service to handle deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
acceptance_criteria: The service should process transactions with the same business rules as the legacy system.
Transactions should be logged and auditable.
Concurrency control must ensure data consistency.

functional_requirements.title: Design Report Generation Module
functional_requirements.description: Create a module in C# for generating financial reports, replacing the VB6 Data Report Designer.
acceptance_criteria: Reports should match the format and data accuracy of the legacy reports.
The module should support exporting reports to PDF and Excel.
Users should be able to schedule automatic report generation.

functional_requirements.title: Containerize Application for Docker
functional_requirements.description: Prepare the application for deployment in a Docker container for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application should run successfully in a Docker container.
Dockerfile should be provided with clear instructions.
Environment variables should be used for configuration settings.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Security Checks
functional_requirements.description: Perform security checks on the modernized application to ensure compliance with security standards.
acceptance_criteria: The application should pass all security vulnerability scans.
Security logs should be implemented for monitoring purposes.
Data encryption should be applied to sensitive information.

functional_requirements.title: Validate Requirements
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all functional requirements are met and validated against the legacy system.
acceptance_criteria: All functional requirements should be traceable to legacy functionalities.
Validation tests should confirm functional parity with the legacy system.
Stakeholder approval should be obtained for all validated requirements.

functional_requirements.title: Deploy Application for Testing
functional_requirements.description: Deploy the modernized application for local testing in a Docker environment.
acceptance_criteria: The application should be deployable in a local Docker environment.
All functionalities should be testable in the deployed environment.
Deployment scripts should be provided and documented.

project.name: BankingAppModernization
project.objective: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is documented, architecture is designed, services are rewritten, QA/security checks are performed, requirements are validated, and the application is deployed for local Docker testing.

recommended_strategy.name: Full upgrade / translation + remediation
recommended_strategy.rationale: Readiness is relatively high; controlled translation with remediation and equivalence testing is viable.

phases.title: Baseline and equivalence harness
phases.outcome: Capture golden flows and baseline outputs.

phases.title: Incremental migration and dependency replacement
phases.outcome: Migrate forms/modules with dependency risk controls.

phases.title: Hardening and release evidence
phases.outcome: Finalize quality gates and publish evidence pack.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.

top_risks.mitigation: Apply targeted migration playbook and parity tests for this detector pattern.

top_risks.description: Potential data loss during migration from VB6 to C#.
top_risks.mitigation: Implement thorough data validation and backup strategies.

top_risks.description: Security vulnerabilities may arise during code translation.
top_risks.mitigation: Conduct regular security audits and apply patches promptly.

Implement golden-flow harness for parity validation

in_scope: Preserve legacy business behavior and workflows
Migrate UI and code to target stack
Control dependency and data-side risks during migration
out_of_scope: Development of new features beyond the existing legacy functionalities.
Integration with third-party services not currently part of the legacy system.

musts: No critical workflow regression for P0 flows
Traceability from requirements to tests and evidence artifacts
shoulds: Preserve DB contracts unless explicitly approved to change

items.title: Translate Login Form to C#
items.outcome: Convert the VB6 login form to a C# form, maintaining existing authentication logic.
acceptance_criteria: The login form should authenticate users using the same credentials as the legacy system.
The form should display appropriate error messages for invalid credentials.
Successful login should redirect users to the main dashboard.

items.title: Implement Customer Management Service
items.outcome: Create a C# service for managing customer data, replacing the legacy VB6 functionality.
acceptance_criteria: The service should allow CRUD operations on customer data.
Data integrity must be maintained during all operations.
The service should log all operations for audit purposes.

items.title: Develop Transaction Processing Service
items.outcome: Implement a C# service to handle deposits, withdrawals, and transfers.
acceptance_criteria: The service should process transactions with the same business rules as the legacy system.
Transactions should be logged and auditable.
Concurrency control must ensure data consistency.

items.title: Design Report Generation Module
items.outcome: Create a module in C# for generating financial reports, replacing the VB6 Data Report Designer.
acceptance_criteria: Reports should match the format and data accuracy of the legacy reports.
The module should support exporting reports to PDF and Excel.
Users should be able to schedule automatic report generation.

items.title: Containerize Application for Docker
items.outcome: Prepare the application for deployment in a Docker container for local testing.
acceptance_criteria: The application should run successfully in a Docker container.
Dockerfile should be provided with clear instructions.
Environment variables should be used for configuration settings.

items.title: Implement Security Checks
items.outcome: Perform security checks on the modernized application to ensure compliance with security standards.
acceptance_criteria: The application should pass all security vulnerability scans.
Security logs should be implemented for monitoring purposes.
Data encryption should be applied to sensitive information.

items.title: Validate Requirements
items.outcome: Ensure all functional requirements are met and validated against the legacy system.
acceptance_criteria: All functional requirements should be traceable to legacy functionalities.
Validation tests should confirm functional parity with the legacy system.
Stakeholder approval should be obtained for all validated requirements.

items.title: Deploy Application for Testing
items.outcome: Deploy the modernized application for local testing in a Docker environment.
acceptance_criteria: The application should be deployable in a local Docker environment.
All functionalities should be testable in the deployed environment.
Deployment scripts should be provided and documented.

items.title: Performance Optimization
items.outcome: Ensure the modernized application performs efficiently under expected load.
acceptance_criteria: The application should handle 1000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
Average response time should not exceed 200ms.
Performance tests should be conducted and documented.

items.title: Scalability
items.outcome: Design the application to scale horizontally to accommodate future growth.
acceptance_criteria: The architecture should support horizontal scaling.
Load tests should demonstrate scalability to 10x current user base.
Documentation should include scaling strategies.

items.title: Reliability
items.outcome: Ensure the application is reliable and available with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: The application should have an uptime of 99.9% or higher.
Failover mechanisms should be implemented and tested.
Downtime should be minimized during deployments.

items.title: Usability
items.outcome: Enhance the user interface for better usability and accessibility.
acceptance_criteria: The user interface should be intuitive and easy to navigate.
Accessibility standards should be met for all user interfaces.
Usability tests should result in a satisfaction score of 4.5 or higher.

items.title: Security Compliance
items.outcome: Ensure the application complies with relevant security standards.
acceptance_criteria: The application should be free from OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
Regular security audits should be conducted.
Security policies should be documented and enforced.

principles: Preserve critical legacy behavior first; modernization must prove functional equivalence.

No breaking change to data contracts without approved migration path and rollback evidence.
